name: Wix
description: Opens each Wix template preview and saves it as HTML + assets.
url_help: Optional. A Wix template listing page, e.g. https://www.wix.com/website/templates/html/business. Empty = the 15 pages built into the crawler.

name: Webflow
description: Opens a Webflow template's live preview and saves it as HTML + assets.
url_help: Optional. Empty = all Webflow templates (https://webflow.com/templates/all). Or paste a category page, a template page (webflow.com/templates/html/<name>) or a <name>.webflow.io site, one per line.

name: Envato Elements
description: Reads Envato Elements web templates, opens each one's Live preview (the author's demo site) and saves it as HTML + assets.
url_help: Optional. Empty = https://elements.envato.com/web-templates (every page). Or paste another Envato Elements listing (e.g. .../web-templates/site-templates) or a single item page, one per line.

name: Free Website Templates
description: Reads freewebsitetemplates.com listing pages and saves each template's live preview as HTML + assets.
url_help: Optional. Empty = https://freewebsitetemplates.com/ (all listing pages). Or paste a listing page (.../templates/page-2) or a template (.../preview/<name>/), one per line.

name: WP Astra
description: Reads WP Astra Starter Template listings and saves each template's live demo site as HTML + assets.
url_help: Optional. Empty = https://wpastra.com/website-templates/business/ (all pages). Or paste another category page, a template page (wpastra.com/templates/<name>/) or a websitedemos.net/<name> address, one per line.
